events.title: Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: In Vino Veritas will be taking part in the Steam Next Fest in October 2026! If you haven't already, be sure to try out the demo!

events.title: 6 New Languages Added!
events.summary: I want the game to be enjoyed by as many people as possible. Even though most people can get by in English these days, I know it can be frustrating to play a game while translating everything in your head at the same time. That's why I decided to go the extra mile and add six more languages! Added Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, German, French and Spanish localizations, on top of the base Italian and English!Try the In Vino Veritas demo now!

events.title: The demo looks different now!

I'm happy to announce that a new version of the demo has been released today, featuring all the changes gathered over that time, to make the experience more enjoyable and to smooth out the little issues players ran into.
